name: Misha Arsellec Lune
original_name: 彌紗・アルトセルク・リューン
source:
Misha is an honest and single-minded girl at heart. Though she acts more mature than she looks, you can't deny that she's quite childish.

She is a Reyvateil, a person who has the power to change sound into magic. More specifically, she is a very rare kind, called a Pureblooded β-type. Because of this, she has very strong, innate powers.

Despite her looks, she is bright, intelligent, and actually quite good at cooking. With her ability to calmly analyze her surroundings, she can do anything skillfully, but she has horrible physical reflexes (she's a klutz). She is also afraid of heights.

She was born in Platina, a city located in the Upper World of the tower, but she is currently living in the Lower World. She seems to know [url=/c3681]Lyner[/url]. She also seems to look much younger than she should be...

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
